scope: Read-only inspection of an owned four-byte source. DELETE permission was opened and closed without setting deletion or moving anything.
script:
import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as w
import json
k=c.WinDLL('kernel32',use_last_error=True)
k.CreateFileW.argtypes=[w.LPCWSTR,w.DWORD,w.DWORD,c.c_void_p,w.DWORD,w.DWORD,w.HANDLE]
k.CreateFileW.restype=w.HANDLE
k.ReOpenFile.argtypes=[w.HANDLE,w.DWORD,w.DWORD,w.DWORD]
k.ReOpenFile.restype=w.HANDLE
k.CloseHandle.argtypes=[w.HANDLE]
path=r'C:\Users\yagol\AppData\Local\Temp\voldiq-admission-hIBJLu\owned.bin'
results=[]
for access in [0x80,0x100080,0x80000000]:
    original=k.CreateFileW(path,access,7,None,3,0x300000,None)
    if original==c.c_void_p(-1).value: raise c.WinError(c.get_last_error())
    try:
        for flags in [0x300000,0x200000,0]:
            handle=k.ReOpenFile(original,0x10080,1,flags)
            error=c.get_last_error() if handle==c.c_void_p(-1).value else 0
            results.append({'originalAccess':hex(access),'reopenFlags':hex(flags),'error':error})
            if not error:k.CloseHandle(handle)
    finally:k.CloseHandle(original)
print(json.dumps(results))
